# Contributing to TheColliery

Issues, bug reports and pull requests are welcome in every TheColliery repository. A repository's own `CONTRIBUTING.md` wins where it has one; this is the default for the rest.

1. **Open an issue first** for anything beyond a typo: the problem, the gap or the change you want.
2. **Follow the repository's gates.** Its README names the commands. The shared shapes live in the [Series Canon](https://github.com/TheColliery/.github/blob/main/SERIES-CANON.md) and the [Public-Doc Pattern](https://github.com/TheColliery/.github/blob/main/DOC-PATTERN.md).
3. **Send a pull request.** Its template is the checklist: tests written first, docs and CHANGELOG updated, the reviewer named.

Everyone taking part follows the [Contributor Covenant](https://github.com/TheColliery/.github/blob/main/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). New to open source? The [Open Source Guides](https://opensource.guide/) explain how contributing works.

Contributions are licensed under the repository's own outbound licence; there is no separate CLA. This is a small team: replies are best effort, with no promised turnaround. Security reports never go in a public issue; see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/TheColliery/.github/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md).
